about.title: About Me
about.heading: DEVELOP, OPTIMIZE, INNOVATE.
about.name: Noah TOFFA
about.paragraph1: , a developer specialized in Linux systems, backend development and automation. I built my expertise through daily practice - understanding how things work at a deep level, and improving them.
about.paragraph2: A strong advocate of the open-source ecosystem, particularly Arch Linux, I specialize in system development in C/C++, designing APIs and backends with FastAPI or Express.js, automating complex workflows, and integrating artificial intelligence into concrete systems.

systemsProgramming.title: Systems Programming
systemsProgramming.description: Design and development of low-level software using C and C++. Focus on performance, memory management, and Linux system internals.

fullStackDevelopment.title: Full-Stack Development
fullStackDevelopment.description: End-to-end application development using Angular, FastAPI, and Flutter. From backend APIs to responsive web and mobile interfaces.

softwareArchitecture.title: Software Architecture

networkBackendEngineering.title: Network & Backend Engineering
